title: Review of c51's reactive-Marangoni flames negative: on fresh seeds 4 and 5 the inverse-sign spots (m -0.15) sit still and split once (3/3 persistent splits, generation 1, at most 1.3 body lengths), no farther than the m 0 twin (0.7/1.4); m -0.6 gives 32 still points; world dt/2 gives the same counts
summary: Re-ran world.py with labkit as in runs.sh (600 frames x 25 steps, T=600): m -0.15 and m 0 on seeds 4 and 5, m -0.15 at world dt 0.02 (50 steps per frame; labkit's time axis then reads 2x, so its speeds halve, the per-frame dynamics match) on seed 4, and m -0.6 on seed 4. m -0.15: 7/7 spots at t=600, 4/1 persistent tracks, 3/3 persistent splits, generation 1, max 1.3/1.3 body lengths; m 0 twin: seed 4 burns out (0 components at t=600), seed 5 8 spots, 6 persistent splits, generation 2, max 1.4 body lengths; dt/2: identical counts (3 persistent splits, max 1.3 lengths); m -0.6: 32 persistent still points, max 1.1 body lengths. pack_m15/seed4/sheet.png: a strong initial burst at t=25 leaves 4 spots that stay in place, swell and split in place.

observations.finding: pack_m15/seed4/sheet.png t=50-600: four burning spots stay at their positions, elongate and split in place (t=313-444), no translation; FACTS max 1.3 body lengths, as the m 0 twin (pack_m0/seed5: 1.4). pack_m60/FACTS.md: 32 still points, max 1.1 body lengths.

seeds_run.result: pass (negative reproduces): m -0.15 max 1.3 body lengths, 3 persistent splits gen 1; m 0 burns out; m -0.6 32 still points
pass: m -0.15 max 1.3 body lengths, 3 persistent splits; m 0 1.4 body lengths, 6 persistent splits gen 2
pass at world dt 0.02 (m -0.15): identical counts

not_checked: the normal-sign (m > 0) and fuel-set-tension (mt 0) arms of the screen
verdicts.limitation: Small populations (4-8 spots after the initial burst), one grid, T=600; I re-ran only the inverse-sign arm, its twin and m -0.6.
